meta.title: [http-client-python] Add support for uv package manager alongside pip
meta.body_summary: Add automatic package manager detection preferring uv over pip for http-client-python installation scripts, enabling uv-created venvs to work without pip and claiming faster installations.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added uv support with package manager abstraction; multiple maintainer review rounds focused on design consistency, code cleanup, and import style; merged after 98h with no performance benchmark.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 607 changed lines across 9 files, this is a medium-sized refactor by absolute volume. It fits a moderate incremental build-tooling PR that merged after multiple rounds of review and iterative improvement.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainers requested complete package manager abstraction, removal of scattered if-checks, elimination of duplicate code, and use of absolute imports. The PR evolved from initial uv detection to a unified install_packages function and reuse of create_venv_with_package_manager across scripts.
review_details.performance_claim: Using uv instead of pip for package installations provides faster installation times and avoids pip dependency in uv-created environments.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Multi-round iterative design refinement over several days, with maintainers guiding abstraction pattern, code deduplication, and import style. Agent successfully incorporated feedback without functional failure, but required human direction on architecture.

detection_detail.code_reading: Multiple maintainers reviewed the code via inline comments, focusing on abstraction design, code duplication, and import conventions. No automated testing or profiling was used.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or timing data; performance claim is narrative. Functional correctness can be tested but not directly verified from PR materials.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: All review feedback led to commits within the same PR; no revert or separate follow-up.

core_change_summary.description: Added package_manager.py with detect_package_manager(), get_install_command(), install_packages(), and create_venv_with_package_manager() to abstract uv/pip selection. Updated install.py, prepare.py, venvtools.py, and build_pygen_wheel.py to use these abstractions instead of hardcoded pip, enabling uv-created venvs to work without pip dependency. Added changeset documentation.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Changes to .github/CODEOWNERS and Submit-AzureSdkForNetPr.ps1 are from merging main and unrelated; .chronus changesets document the fix.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: added package_manager.py with detection logic and updated install.py to use uv/pip conditionally.
Fixed ensurepip error by using uv venv when uv available, added MockVenvContext.
Iterative review: removed debug prints, refactored to use package manager abstraction in all scripts.
Per iscai-msft request, completed full abstraction: removed scattered if checks, centralized all installations through install_packages().
Addressed code cleanup: removed unused create_venv_with_package function, removed duplicate ExtendedEnvBuilder class, changed to absolute import.
Updated build_pygen_wheel.py and prepare.py to use create_venv_with_package_manager for consistency.
Removed unused imports and unused create function from venvtools.py; ran formatter.
